top_news.title: Better Together: Complementary Query Rewriting Under a Strong RAG Baseline
top_news.dek: Researchers evaluated whether query rewriting improves RAG performance when using a high-quality retrieval and reranking pipeline.
top_news.brief: The study tested four query-rewriting strategies against strong baselines like HyDE and Query2Doc across three datasets. Results suggest that when using a competitive pipeline—incorporating BGE dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and MMR diversification—the marginal gains from query rewriting are limited.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing RAG pipeline components including retrieval and reranking

top_news.title: Serving LLMs on Tenstorrent Hardware: Inside the vLLM TT Plugin
top_news.dek: The new vLLM TT plugin enables Tenstorrent hardware support via vLLM's out-of-tree platform mechanism.
top_news.brief: The plugin allows Tenstorrent accelerators to be used with vLLM without changing the existing OpenAI-compatible API or client code. It automatically registers Tenstorrent hardware when the TT-Metal library is detected, abstracting the underlying architectural differences from the user.
top_news.image_alt: Tenstorrent hardware logo and vLLM architecture diagram

top_news.title: Large language models develop novel social biases through adaptive exploration
top_news.dek: A new study investigates how large language models acquire novel social biases through adaptive exploration.
top_news.brief: The research explores the mechanisms by which LLMs develop social biases during adaptive learning processes. The findings highlight potential risks in model behavior when systems are allowed to explore and adapt in social contexts.
top_news.image_alt: Abstract representation of neural network bias and social data

top_news.title: Hackers are stealing Claude tokens from subscribers
top_news.dek: Anthropic warns users of ongoing attacks involving stolen Claude API tokens.
top_news.brief: Last month, a Claude user noticed his account was consuming tokens even though he wasn't working. Anthropic has since warned users about hackers.

primary.summary: A voice agent has to decide, at every pause, whether the user has finished speaking. primary.title: Radar - Radar search now includes Internet events
primary.summary: Cloudflare Radar search now includes Internet events and outages alongside existing results. Search event descriptions or related entities, such as locations, ASes, bots, and top-level domains, to find relevant events and open the most relevant Radar view. These results are also available to browser-based AI agents through WebMCP.

primary.title: Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page
primary.summary: We look at r-1, the document parsing model Reducto released on September 1, 2026. We walk through how it folds OCR, layout detection, tables, formatting and grounding into one full page pass, replacing the multi stage agentic pipeline it ships alongside. We break down the two numbers that matter for a migration decision: a reported 20% error reduction and a flat 1 cent per page rate against the legacy 3 to 6 cents. The post Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page appeared first on MarkTechPost.
